Variants.Content: Valens shares Roman imperial legitimacy with the western court. Appointments and laws uphold authority; troops expect pay, districts protection and churches a voice in bishops and belief.

Valens shares Roman imperial legitimacy with the western court. Military recognition also rests on rewards and relief; a title needs willing action. Appointments and laws still need military and local implementation.
